description: Draft and revise natural, specific, individually voiced prose while preserving the writer's meaning.

defaultPrompt: Rewrite this draft naturally without changing its claims.
Match this writing sample's voice in a new draft.
Review this story's structure before polishing the prose.
interface.longDescription: Draft, rewrite, review, and voice-match prose using sentence-level editing patterns and narrative-level choices. The workflow preserves factual claims, avoids artificial mistakes, and applies StoryScope-inspired structural analysis only when the text tells a story.

name: Human-Writing
